value.rationale: At fixed three plant degrees and pollinator richness, every network has identical per-plant support, expected supported-plant count and probability of at least one supported plant, but the global optimizer of full joint support switches sharply from disconnected paired modules to a common core. The structural phase diagram applies to all d>=2s>=2 and isolates a meaningful high-order vulnerability invisible to degree-only first moments. This is an interpretable analytical benchmark, not an empirical ecological prescription.
